mapper.select: select lab_name as label, cast(id as char) as value from lab where deleted = 0 and department_id = #{departmentId} order by lab_name asc, id asc

select count(distinct r.id) from lab_reservation r join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id join lab_reservation_slot s on s.reservation_id = r.id where l.deleted = 0 and l.department_id = #{departmentId} and s.slot_status = 1 and s.reservation_date = #{today}
select count(*) from lab_reservation r join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id where l.deleted = 0 and l.department_id = #{departmentId} and r.status = 1
select count(*) from lab_device d join lab l on l.id = d.lab_id where d.deleted = 0 and l.deleted = 0 and l.department_id = #{departmentId} and d.status != 1
select count(*) from lab_device d join lab l on l.id = d.lab_id where d.deleted = 0 and l.deleted = 0 and l.department_id = #{departmentId} and d.status = 2
select count(*) from lab_consumable c join lab l on l.id = c.lab_id where c.deleted = 0 and l.deleted = 0 and l.department_id = #{departmentId} and c.stock_quantity <= c.warning_threshold

select count(*) from user_violation_record v join sys_user u on u.id = v.user_id left join lab_reservation r on r.id = v.reservation_id left join ( select s.reservation_id, min(s.reservation_date) as first_date from lab_reservation_slot s where s.slot_status = 1 group by s.reservation_id ) slot on slot.reservation_id = v.reservation_id where u.deleted = 0 and u.department_id = #{departmentId} and coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)) between #{startDate} and #{endDate}
select avg(u.credit_score) from sys_user u where u.deleted = 0 and u.department_id = #{departmentId}

mapper.select: select count(*) from class_period where status = 1

mapper.select:
select count(*)
and v.violation_type = #{violationType}

select v.violation_type as name, count(*) as value
group by v.violation_type

select u.id, u.real_name as name, u.user_no as secondary, u.credit_score as value from sys_user u where u.deleted = 0 and u.department_id = #{departmentId} and u.credit_score < #{lowCreditScore} order by u.credit_score asc, u.id asc limit 10

select u.id, u.real_name as name, u.user_no as secondary, count(v.id) as value
group by u.id, u.real_name, u.user_no order by value desc, u.id asc limit 10

select date_format(coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') as name, count(*) as value
group by date_format(coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') order by name asc

select date_format(coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') as name, count(*) as value
and v.violation_type = 2 group by date_format(coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') order by name asc

select date_format(coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') as name, count(*) as value
and v.violation_type = 1 group by date_format(coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)), '%Y-%m-%d') order by name asc

select case when u.credit_score < 60 then 'LT60' when u.credit_score < 70 then '60_69' when u.credit_score < 80 then '70_79' when u.credit_score < 90 then '80_89' else 'GTE90' end as name, count(*) as value from sys_user u where u.deleted = 0 and u.department_id = #{departmentId} group by name order by value desc, name asc

select case when exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role role on role.id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.id and role.role_code in ('TEACHER', 'ROLE_TEACHER') ) then 'TEACHER' else 'STUDENT' end as name, count(*) as value
group by name

select r.reservation_type as name, count(*) as value from user_violation_record v join sys_user u on u.id = v.user_id join lab_reservation r on r.id = v.reservation_id left join ( select s.reservation_id, min(s.reservation_date) as first_date from lab_reservation_slot s where s.slot_status = 1 group by s.reservation_id ) slot on slot.reservation_id = v.reservation_id where u.deleted = 0 and u.department_id = #{departmentId} and coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by r.reservation_type

select case when hour(coalesce(slot.first_start_at, r.created_at)) < 12 then 'MORNING' when hour(coalesce(slot.first_start_at, r.created_at)) < 18 then 'AFTERNOON' else 'EVENING' end as name, count(*) as value from user_violation_record v join sys_user u on u.id = v.user_id left join lab_reservation r on r.id = v.reservation_id left join ( select s.reservation_id, min(timestamp(s.reservation_date, p.start_time)) as first_start_at, min(s.reservation_date) as first_date from lab_reservation_slot s join class_period p on p.id = s.period_id where s.slot_status = 1 group by s.reservation_id ) slot on slot.reservation_id = v.reservation_id where u.deleted = 0 and u.department_id = #{departmentId} and coalesce(slot.first_date, date(r.created_at)) between #{startDate} and #{endDate} group by name
